verdict.rationale: Whether a product analytics platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Mixpanel releasing its source code or naming an open-source license. The pack covers hosted analytics, export APIs, JQL custom queries and an MCP server, none of which make the product's source readable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
